mn100:5.3: “That Blessed One, dearest boy, has arrived at Caṇḍalakappa, and is staying at Caṇḍalakappa in the mango grove of the Todeyya brahmins.
mn100:18.6: Just the same, Bhāradvāja, when breathing through my mouth and nose was blocked, severe winds came out my ears making a severe noise.
mn100:19.6: Just the same, Bhāradvāja, when breathing through my mouth, nose, and ears was blocked, severe winds ground my head.
mn100:20.6: Just the same, Bhāradvāja, when breathing through my mouth, nose, and ears was blocked, I got a severe headache.
mn100:21.6: Just the same, Bhāradvāja, when breathing through my mouth, nose, and ears was blocked, severe winds carved up my belly.
mn100:22.6: Just the same, Bhāradvāja, when breathing through my mouth, nose, and ears was blocked, there was a severe burning in my body.
mn100:23.7: The ascetic Gotama is a perfected one; such is the conduct of a perfected one.’
mn100:27.3: Whatever ascetics and brahmins will experience painful, sharp, severe, acute feelings due to exertion in the future—this is as far as it goes, no-one has done more than this;
mn100:27.4: Whatever ascetics and brahmins are experiencing painful, sharp, severe, acute feelings due to exertion right now—this is as far as it goes, no-one has done more than this.
mn100:30.3: Why don’t I eat some solid food, some rice and porridge?’
